tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Count business days between two dates, or add/subtract N business days from a date, skipping weekends and (optionally) the country's official public holidays. Returns the holidays skipped. Exact; do not do this in your head.

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: List official public holidays for 100+ countries for a given year (date, local name, English name, national or regional), from the Nager.Date open dataset.

tools.name: timezone_convert
tools.description: Convert a date/time from one IANA time zone to one or more others with correct daylight-saving rules. Returns local times, UTC offsets, abbreviations and the UTC instant.

tools.name: cron_next
tools.description: Parse a cron expression and return the next N run times in a time zone (DST-aware), plus a plain-English description. Validates syntax.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Exact unit conversion across length, mass, volume, area, speed, time, data size (SI and binary), energy, pressure, power and temperature using standard definitions.

tools.name: currency_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between ~30 currencies using European Central Bank reference rates (latest or historical date since 1999). Reference rates, not executable quotes.

tools.name: json_repair
tools.description: Fix malformed JSON typically produced by LLMs: code fences, leading prose, single quotes, unquoted keys, trailing commas, comments, Python True/False/None, NaN, missing closing brackets. Returns the parsed JSON and a list of fixes.

tools.name: json_validate
tools.description: Validate data against a JSON Schema (core keywords incl. type, required, properties, enum, pattern, formats, anyOf/oneOf, $ref). Returns every error with its JSON path. Use before returning structured output.

tools.name: regex_test
tools.description: Run a JavaScript regular expression against text and return all matches with index, capture groups and named groups, or the replaced text. Confirms a regex works before you rely on it.

tools.name: csv_to_json
tools.description: Parse CSV/TSV (RFC 4180 quotes, auto-detected delimiter) into JSON rows with inferred numbers/booleans, plus column names and row count.

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Compare two texts line-by-line or word-by-word and return a unified-style diff with counts of added/removed/unchanged and a similarity score.

tools.name: hash_encode
tools.description: Compute SHA-1/256/384/512 hashes or encode/decode base64, base64url, hex, URL and HTML entities, or decode a JWT's header and payload (signature not verified).

tools.name: uuid_generate
tools.description: Generate cryptographically random UUIDs, v4 or time-sortable v7.

tools.name: semver_compare
tools.description: Compare two semantic versions (incl. prerelease ordering) or test whether a version satisfies an npm-style range (^, ~, x, comparators, ||).

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Count characters, words, sentences, paragraphs and lines, estimate LLM tokens and reading time, and compute a Flesch reading-ease score.

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: Convert text to a clean URL slug: transliterates accents (é→e, ß→ss), drops punctuation, collapses separators, trims to a word boundary.

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the language of a text (25+ languages via script detection and stopword profiles) with ISO 639-1 code, name and confidence.
